data.description: Two lanes side by side make the 3 ft Double Wave Slide a favourite for small children who like to slide with a friend. Each lane rises and dips in a wave, so the ride has two gentle bumps on the way down. The slide is Play Red and climbs from a steel ladder at the back. At 3 ft high it is sized for younger children, and the double lane lets two go at once, which keeps the queue short at a busy play school or society garden. The ladder's galvanised pipe and the moulded lanes fall under our 3-year warranty for manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing that shows the slide and its exit zone.

items.pText: Two lanes side by side make the 3 ft Double Wave Slide a favourite for small children who like to slide with a friend. Each lane rises and dips in a wave, so the ride has two gentle bumps on the way down. The slide is Play Red and climbs from a steel ladder at the back. At 3 ft high it is sized for younger children, and the double lane lets two go at once, which keeps the queue short at a busy play school or society garden. The ladder's galvanised pipe and the moulded lanes fall under our 3-year warranty for manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing that shows the slide and its exit zone.

A galvanised steel ladder leads up to the twin-lane slide bed. Our team installs it self-standing or by grouting, depending on the base. Two children leave the slide at the same time, so keep the exit area wide and clear, and inspect both lanes and the ladder during routine maintenance.
